backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing public and personal songs with upload, validation, access control, and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing changes to the Library page search bar and reusable CSS for non-sticky layout.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files detailing styles, components, pages, and behaviors.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata, favicon, and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration with theme provider and multiple app routes including admin.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminRoute: Component that restricts admin routes based on authentication and admin status with fallback UI.
frontend/src/components/admin/GrantAdmin: Admin form allowing granting admin access by validating and submitting a Principal ID.
frontend/src/components/admin/RequestAdm: Shows an access-denied card displaying the user's principal ID with copy-to-clipboard and a loading state.
frontend/src/components/admin/SongEditor: Dialog for creating or editing songs with form fields, validation, file handling, and upload or edit submission logic.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: A sign-in/sign-out button using Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/branding/Fourlea: Renders the Fourleaf brand logo in multiple visual variants (full, icon, compact).
frontend/src/components/catalog/CatalogS: Displays a song row with cover art, play controls, metadata, and a download button.
frontend/src/components/catalog/Download: Download button that checks authentication and subscription status and triggers audio file download.
frontend/src/components/catalog/PublicSo: Dialog for uploading public songs with validation, file inputs, progress tracking, and auth checks.
frontend/src/components/home/HorizontalS: A horizontally scrollable row with snap behavior for child elements.
frontend/src/components/home/StreamingCa: Interactive card showing song details, cover art, and a play button with transition context setup.
frontend/src/components/home/StreamingSe: Section wrapper that displays a titled content block with an optional icon and 'Show all' button.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level layout managing sidebars, header, routing outlet, audio player bar, and profile setup dialog.
frontend/src/components/layout/HeaderSea: Header search bar providing navigation, query input, and a browse menu with keyboard and click handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/HomeTabBa: Tab bar for switching between All, Music, and Podcast browsing views.
frontend/src/components/layout/LeftSideb: Collapsible navigation sidebar with branding, links, admin checks, and mobile drawer behavior.
frontend/src/components/layout/RightDeta: Right-side panel showing details of the currently playing song or a placeholder when nothing is playing.
frontend/src/components/personal/Persona: Dialog for uploading personal songs with metadata fields, validation, file inputs, progress, and error diagnostics.
frontend/src/components/player/AudioPlay: Audio player bar managing playback, streaming URLs, time updates, volume, and queue navigation via hooks.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Dialog prompting new authenticated users to enter a name and subscription status, saving the profile via mutations.
frontend/src/components/settings/UISound: UI sound settings panel with toggle and volume slider controlled through a custom settings hook.
frontend/src/components/upload/UploadDia: Dialog fetching and displaying upload permission diagnostics, with copy-to-clipboard and retry support.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and caching an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidating related queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioQueue.ts: Zustand store managing the audio queue, playback state, timing, seeking, and now-playing UI state.
frontend/src/hooks/useHeaderSearch.ts: Zustand store for managing the header search query with setters and a clear function.
frontend/src/hooks/useHomeBrowsing.ts: Zustand store tracking the active home tab and scroll requests, with utilities to update or reset browsing state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, wrapping AuthClient and exposing login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating song data, user profiles, and uploads using the backend actor and identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useUISounds.ts: Creates a hook to play UI click sounds respecting user sound settings and volume.
frontend/src/hooks/useUISoundSettings.ts: Stores UI sound settings in Zustand with persistence, managing enabled state and volume.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode palette, UI utilities, and layout tweaks.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin UI for browsing, editing, creating, and deleting catalog songs with dialogs and song management actions.
frontend/src/pages/LibraryPage.tsx: Displays the public song catalog with filtering, browsing sections, recommendations, and playback integration.
frontend/src/pages/MyLibraryPage.tsx: Displays the user's personal song library with search, playback, upload, and removal functionality, handling authentication states and loading.
frontend/src/pages/NowPlayingPage.tsx: Shows a full-screen now-playing interface with artwork, playback controls, time slider, volume control, and navigation handling.
frontend/src/pages/PlayerLayoutPage.tsx: Provides a multi-pane player layout with sidebar navigation, hero section, playback controls, and a sample track list using global audio queue state.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Renders subscription pricing plans with features, discounts, and a call-to-action for starting a trial.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Normalizes backend error messages into user-friendly text and detects authorization-related errors.
frontend/src/utils/buildSongUpdate.ts: Constructs a typed song update payload for uploads, including optional cover images only when provided.
frontend/src/utils/uploadValidation.ts: Provides validation utilities for audio files, cover images, durations, and required fields with size limits.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, storing and retrieving values in sessionStorage, and syncing URL params with session state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, known issues, and feature requirements related to fixing the Library page search bar’s positioning behavior.
